unit_cn: Unit 5 Into the Wild 走进自然
source: 外研社(新标准)2019必修第一册 Unit 5 词表(p49-59 真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、野生动物/自然主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: A local wildlife charity is working to save the rare cranes.
words.example_cn: 一个本地野生动物慈善机构正在努力拯救稀有的鹤。

words.example_en: The monarch butterfly is famous for its long autumn journey south.
words.example_cn: 黑脉金斑蝶以其漫长的秋季南迁而闻名。

words.example_en: A huge whale rose slowly to the surface near our boat.
words.example_cn: 一头巨大的鲸缓缓浮到我们船边的水面上。

words.example_en: Every autumn these birds begin their annual journey to warmer lands.
words.example_cn: 每年秋天这些鸟都开始它们一年一度的迁往温暖地区的旅程。

words.example_en: The migration of the monarch butterfly is one of nature's wonders.
words.example_cn: 黑脉金斑蝶的迁徙是大自然的奇迹之一。

words.example_en: Many animals migrate to find food or warmer weather.
words.example_cn: 许多动物迁徙是为了寻找食物或更温暖的天气。

words.example_en: These insects migrate to seek a partner and warmer weather.
words.example_cn: 这些昆虫迁徙是为了寻找配偶和更温暖的天气。

words.example_en: A professor and his team finally solved the mystery of the butterfly.
words.example_cn: 一位教授和他的团队终于解开了这种蝴蝶之谜。

words.example_en: The butterfly uses its eyes to measure the position of the sun.
words.example_cn: 这种蝴蝶用眼睛来测量太阳的位置。

words.example_en: By checking the sun's position, the bird knows which way to fly.
words.example_cn: 通过查看太阳的位置,这只鸟便知道该往哪个方向飞。

words.example_en: These two clues help the butterfly determine the way to go.
words.example_cn: 这两条线索帮助蝴蝶确定前进的方向。

words.example_en: Eventually, the monarchs reach the forests where they spend the winter.
words.example_cn: 最终,这些黑脉金斑蝶到达它们过冬的森林。

words.example_en: Scientists searched for years before they found the solution to the puzzle.
words.example_cn: 科学家们找了多年才找到这个谜题的答案。

words.example_en: How these tiny insects find their way was a mystery for a long time.
words.example_cn: 这些小昆虫如何找到路曾长期是个谜。

words.example_en: The monarch's amazing ability to navigate surprised everyone.
words.example_cn: 黑脉金斑蝶惊人的导航能力让所有人都很吃惊。

words.example_en: The number of these butterflies has crashed in the last few years.
words.example_cn: 这些蝴蝶的数量在过去几年里暴跌。

words.example_en: People are destroying the natural environment that wild animals need.
words.example_cn: 人们正在破坏野生动物所需要的自然环境。

words.example_en: Farmers use chemicals that kill the plants the caterpillars eat.
words.example_cn: 农民使用的化学品杀死了毛虫所吃的植物。

words.example_en: The more we know about this creature, the better we can protect it.
words.example_cn: 我们对这种生物了解得越多,就越能保护它。

words.example_en: With our help, these butterflies have a better chance to survive.
words.example_cn: 有了我们的帮助,这些蝴蝶就更有可能存活下来。

words.example_en: Cutting down trees has a serious effect on wild animals.
words.example_cn: 砍伐树木对野生动物有严重的影响。

words.example_en: Each caterpillar must eat a lot of leaves before it becomes a butterfly.
words.example_cn: 每条毛虫在变成蝴蝶之前都必须吃很多叶子。

words.example_en: Our accommodation looked out over a waterhole full of wild animals.
words.example_cn: 我们的住处俯瞰一处满是野生动物的水塘。

words.example_en: Many English idioms use the names of animals, such as 'as busy as a bee'.
words.example_cn: 许多英语习语都用到动物的名字,比如"忙得像只蜜蜂"。

words.example_en: The local authority has set up a reserve to protect the wild birds.
words.example_cn: 当地管理机构设立了一个保护区来保护野生鸟类。

words.example_en: Wetlands are an important source of food for many wild birds.
words.example_cn: 湿地是许多野生鸟类重要的食物来源。

words.example_en: The first national park in the world was founded long ago.
words.example_cn: 世界上第一个国家公园在很久以前就创立了。

words.example_en: As a nature photographer, I often work outside in all kinds of weather.
words.example_cn: 作为一名自然摄影师,我经常在各种天气下在户外工作。

words.example_en: I forced my finger to press the button just before the bear ran away.
words.example_cn: 就在那头熊跑开之前,我强迫自己的手指按下了按钮。

words.example_en: When I recovered from the shock, I looked down at my camera.
words.example_cn: 当我从震惊中恢复过来时,我低头看了看我的相机。

words.example_en: Seeing a bear only metres away gave me a real shock.
words.example_cn: 看到一头熊就在几米之外,让我大吃一惊。

words.example_en: A wildlife photographer must brave the elements to get a good shot.
words.example_cn: 野生动物摄影师必须不顾恶劣天气才能拍到好照片。

words.example_en: The park is famous for the variety of its wildlife.
words.example_cn: 这个公园以其野生动物的多样性而闻名。

words.example_en: My encounter with the bear was both frightening and magical.
words.example_cn: 我与那头熊的相遇既令人害怕又充满魔力。

words.example_en: I followed a narrow path that led me through a dark forest.
words.example_cn: 我沿着一条狭窄的小路穿过一片黑暗的森林。

words.example_en: When I stepped out of the trees, the breathtaking view stopped me.
words.example_cn: 当我走出树林时,那令人惊叹的景色让我停下了脚步。

words.example_en: An eagle flew high over the snow-capped mountains and the still lake.
words.example_cn: 一只鹰在白雪覆盖的群山和平静的湖面上空高高飞过。

words.example_en: While I was concentrating on the scene, I felt that I was being watched.
words.example_cn: 当我专注于眼前的景色时,我感到自己正被注视着。

words.example_en: I turned, saw the bear, and froze, unable to move at all.
words.example_cn: 我转过身,看见那头熊,然后呆住了,完全动弹不得。

words.example_en: With water falling off its hair, the bear stared back at me.
words.example_cn: 水从它的毛发上滴落,那头熊回瞪着我。

words.meaning_cn: (用图片或文字)记录;捕捉;俘获
words.example_en: My most frightening experience was now captured forever in one image.
words.example_cn: 我最惊险的经历如今被永远地记录在一张图片里。

words.example_en: The whole magical scene was held forever in a single image.
words.example_cn: 整个奇妙的场景被永远定格在一张图像里。

words.example_en: His calm reaction when he saw the bear surprised the whole class.
words.example_cn: 他看到熊时冷静的反应让全班同学都很惊讶。

words.example_en: We made an animal fact file about the red-crowned crane.
words.example_cn: 我们做了一份关于丹顶鹤的动物档案。

words.example_en: The number of monarchs has fallen by as much as ninety per cent.
words.example_cn: 黑脉金斑蝶的数量已下降了多达百分之九十。
